weather_report:
Early afternoon in Subiaco feels newly polished: a clear, uncomplicated sky and unblinking light that sharpens edges and brightens colors. Forecasts keep it cloudless through the rest of the afternoon and into early evening, so expect a sunny, lucid day with long, clean sightlines. The sun will be assertive; UV is likely high in the mid-afternoon, so favor shade where you can and use sunscreen and sunglasses.

It reads as a pleasant, dry stretch for quiet errands and small rituals. Light, breathable clothing and a hat will suit the hour; bring water if you’re on foot. Consider hanging the washing to catch the honest breeze, tending balcony herbs, or walking to the shops and taking the slower route home through a pocket of park, pausing in the dappled shade as the light begins to mellow.
